findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in an i18next resource bundle
findings.body: This account-ui bundle uses i18next interpolation everywhere else (e.g. {{0}}, {{name}}, <0>{{username}}</0>). Changing error-invalid-multivalued-size to Java MessageFormat syntax '{0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' means the React/i18next renderer will not substitute the arguments or evaluate the choice; users will see the raw placeholders/choice expression instead of 'Attribute X must have at least ... and at most ... values'. The Java-style choice form belongs only in the server-side themes bundles, not this JS bundle.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in an i18next resource bundle
findings.body: This admin-ui bundle is rendered by the JavaScript UI with i18next interpolation ({{0}} style). Changing error-invalid-multivalued-size to '{0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' introduces Java MessageFormat/ChoiceFormat syntax that i18next cannot evaluate, so the validation message will be shown literally with unsubstituted placeholders instead of the attribute name and limits. Keep the {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} form for the JS bundle and use the choice form only in server-side message bundles.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian (messages_lt) account bundle was changed to 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see instructions in the wrong language. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation of 'Install one of the following applications on your mobile:'.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian (messages_lt) login bundle was changed to 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian, not Lithuanian. This is the same wrong-language copy-paste as in the account bundle and will show Italian instructions to Lithuanian users during TOTP setup. Use a Lithuanian translation instead.

findings.title: Missing English bundle aborts verification with an unchecked exception
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives the English file by regex-rewriting the input path and throws a raw RuntimeException when that file cannot be opened. This bypasses verify()'s contract of returning collected messages / throwing MojoExecutionException: a single locale file whose path does not rewrite to an existing _en.properties (e.g. a new locale, a locale containing characters outside [a-zA-Z-_], or a file verified standalone) crashes the whole plugin run instead of reporting a verification problem for that file. Catch this case and report it through the messages list or a MojoExecutionException naming both files.
